verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Cake publishes an llms.txt at its help centre (HTTP 200), with a structured markdown index of help articles, and the help articles themselves are served as .md URLs. An agent can therefore be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation announcing or describing the llms.txt or agent-doc offering, no evidence of an llms-full.txt or of coverage beyond the help centre (e.g., the main site or API docs), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://help.cakeequity.com/llms.txt # Cake Help Centre
